prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice Controlling Your Desktop Companion", "Try moving and clicking your pet on the desktop bar while setup finishes.", "Got It"]
1: ["Choose How You Want to Build Your Companion", "Select an instant ready-made companion or generate a custom pet from your photos.", "Instant Pet vs Custom Photo Pet"]
2: ["Quick Desktop Controls", "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, summon, or open settings.", "Right click for menu; Double click to pet; Drag to move across monitors", "Launch Pet Now"]
3: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your new pet is officially registered to your desktop workspace.", "Verified Desktop Companion"]
4: ["Please sign in with your original email to restore previously created pets."]
5: ["Checking multi-monitor support and desktop display layers...", "Initializing render engine..."]
6: ["Preset pets load instantly. Photo generation takes around 60 seconds."]
7: ["Unlocks Idle Animations & Audio Reactions"]
8: ["Your Pet is Active on Your Desktop!", "Look at the bottom corner of your primary screen. Your pet is now exploring your desktop."]
9: []

verdicts.problem: Mentions unlocking features or paid extras
